decisions: Minutes from the September 6, 2025 board meeting approved with amendment to the Q3 revenue figure (corrected from $4.1M to $4.3M).
Pierre Dubois authorized to establish a revolving credit facility of up to $500,000 with Marbledock's primary banking partner by November 30, 2025.
Aiyana Park authorized to hire or reassign a dedicated senior account manager to the Northwind Partners account by November 22, 2025.
Margaret Holvan to personally schedule an executive alignment meeting with Northwind Partners' CEO in December 2025.
Pierre Dubois to prepare a revised Northwind Partners contract proposal targeting a 12% rate increase for the 2026 renewal, ready by January 15, 2026.
Pierre Dubois to circulate a revised 2026 budget draft incorporating a $200,000 process automation allocation by November 20, 2025.
Board approves engaging Structura Group for Denver office expansion; Aiyana Park authorized to execute a contract not to exceed $375,000, subject to legal review.
Aiyana Park and Margaret Holvan to co-lead the Falcon Ridge Capital RFP response, with an internal draft due by November 17, 2025.
Business development to continue preliminary engagement with Sycamore Health Systems, with a status update due at the December board meeting.
